title: fix(service-automation): a connector credential written through the door reaches every replica
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DEvHfdgE5C54xKaAXm6nH7d)_
Fixes #27428

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：多副本部署里，任一副本通过凭据门写入或清除连接器凭据后，发一条仅含地址的集群广播（`connector-credential.mutated`，载荷 `{ originNode, ref }`）；其它副本收到后跑自己的连接器对账，重读共享凭据行，被挂起的连接器随即恢复。
- 为什么改：此前只有接请求的那个副本恢复，其它副本上被上游拒过的连接器一直挂着，直到元数据重载或重启（裁决 6513279565，字母 A 挂 A1）。
- 风险与回滚：只加一条内部通道，单副本或内存集群驱动下不挂载、行为不变；至多一次投递，丢失由下次重载或重启兜底。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts`（门的发布与收方对账）、`packages/services/service-cluster/src/metadata-cluster-bridge-plugin.ts`（第四条通道）、`packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-credential-cluster.test.ts`（双内核 pin）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/connector-credential-cluster.test.ts`，预期 5 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The publish.** The connector credential door (`PUT|DELETE /api/v1/automation/connectors/credential-refs/:ref`) publishes `{ originNode, ref }` on `connector-credential.mutated` right after `store.set` succeeds and after `store.clear` clears a row, then reconciles its own replica as before. Address only: no value, fingerprint or revision rides the channel. A refused write (400 / 403 / 404 / 409 / 503) publishes nothing. Best-effort and fire-and-forget, like lanes 2 and 3: a publish failure is logged at `warn` and never fails the write.
- **The receiver.** A peer drops its own `originNode`, then runs `reconcileDeclaredConnectors` on its reconcile queue (`materializeDeclaredConnectors(ctx, { fatal: false })`), which re-reads the shared `sys_connector_credential` rows. The row's revision joins each instance's signature, so exactly the instances naming the changed reference re-materialize, held ones included; a cleared reference degrades them, naming it. It logs one `info` line per peer write it follows.
- **The seam.** `AutomationEngine.attachConnectorCredentialPubSub(pubsub, nodeId)` delegates to the plugin's credential door (`ConnectorCredentialDoor.attachClusterPubSub`), idempotent on `(pubsub, nodeId)` and detached at `destroy()`. The channel name and payload type live in `connector-credentials.ts`; nothing new is exported from the package root.
- **Lane 4 in `MetadataClusterBridgePlugin`.** Duck-typed against the `automation` service's `attachConnectorCredentialPubSub()` beside lanes 1 to 3, skipped on the in-process `memory` driver, its own attach error and detach on `kernel:shutdown`.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx` §6.2 gains the lane 4 row; the family's prose now says four lanes and names the credential rows as lane 4's source of truth.
- Changeset: `patch` for `@objectstack/service-automation` and `@objectstack/service-cluster`.

## Why

Ruling 6513279565 on #27428 (letter A, attached at A1): one new address-only lane of the §6.2 family, published by the credential door, received as a reconcile that re-reads the shared row, enumerated in the bridge with the other three lanes. Not a synthetic `metadata.mutated`, no polling, no self-attach inside service-automation.

## Tests

- `packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-credential-cluster.test.ts` (new): two `AutomationServicePlugin` kernels over ONE SQLite database and one shared bus that delivers to every subscriber, publisher included. Each replica is attached through `attachConnectorCredentialPubSub()`, the seam the bridge calls.
  - a PUT on A re-materializes the instance B holds (its stored value was refused upstream, so no retry timer) with the new value, with no reload on B;
  - a DELETE on A degrades B's live instance, naming the reference;
  - control: B with no transport stays held after A's PUT, the pre-fix shape;
  - the payload is exactly `{ originNode, ref }` with partition key `connector-credential:REF`, after a set and after a clear, and a refused write publishes nothing;
  - A's own publish is dropped on A and followed on B, and a write on B reaches A.
- `packages/services/service-cluster/src/metadata-cluster-bridge-plugin.test.ts`: six lane-4 cases (attach on a cross-process driver with the cluster's pubsub and node id, all four lanes together, skip on `memory`, quiet skip with no service or no seam, a throwing attach that leaves lanes 1 to 3 up, detach on shutdown when the lane-3 detach throws).

## Acceptance notes

- The dev's earlier observation on this card (a connector changed by a publish may materialise only on the publishing replica) was not measured here, as the ruling directs; it is the sibling question for its own card.
- `AutomationEngine` gains one public method, the duck-typed seam. The claim's `Clause-②: no` is copied as written; the report asks the seat whether that method counts as a widened public surface.
- Draft PR #27819 also edits `service-automation/src/plugin.ts`; this diff keeps to the door's two publish lines, the receiver and the destroy line, so the later lander merges `main`.

## Verification
